notes.title: Update 1.7 - Performance Boost and Gameplay Enhancements
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring you[b][i] Update 1.7[/i][/b], a flash update designed to optimize performance and enhance gameplay. Stay tuned for [b]Update 1.8[/b], which will be packed with even more features and updates!

[list]
[*] Performance Optimization: Various enhancements to ensure smoother gameplay.
[*] Damage Mechanics: Rats and snakes now inflict damage, adding a new layer of challenge.
[*] Updated Wolf AI: Improved AI components for a more realistic and engaging experience.
[*] Character Movement SFX: Enhanced sound effects for main character movement, improving overall immersion.
[*] UI Enhancements: Centralized text and streamlined page variations for a more cohesive user experience.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We can't wait to share what's next in Update 1.8!

notes.title: Patch 1.6: Elevating Performance and FPS
notes.notes:
[h2][Update 1.6][/h2] - 

- Improved FPS and overall game performance by deactivating the "Lumen" feature.
- Implemented environment changes to further optimize FPS within the game.
- Enhanced blueprints for increased utility and performance.
- Implemented a more realistic behavior for enemy Wolf AI, ensuring it no longer persists in attacking the player after being defeated.
- Optimized the "Toxic Water" material to enhance overall performance and FPS.
- Implemented refined lighting mechanics in specific game segments to enhance control and optimize performance.

[h2][Coming soon][/h2] -
Stay tuned for upcoming updates! We are actively working on further optimizations and bug fixes.

The Total Vengeance roadmap is on the horizon—expect promising additional map locations, intriguing new weapons, formidable enemies, and exciting new characters to be revealed soon.

notes.title: Hot fix patch 1.55
notes.notes:
- Implemented a "How to Play" menu, seamlessly transitioning it from the in-game pop-up to the main menu for enhanced accessibility and user guidance.

- Thirst depletion rate during idle periods has been deliberately decelerated for a more balanced and immersive gameplay experience.

- Radiation now diminishes exclusively in proximity to waste barrels, ceasing its continual reduction over time. When radiation levels reach or dip below zero, the player's health undergoes rapid decline unless counteracted with a health pack. "Energy drinks" are now available to restore the radiation meter.

- Hunger no longer results in player death, and a resolution is actively being pursued for this issue.

- Bug issues fixed

** Game roadmap & updates coming soon.

notes.title: Total Vengeance 1.52 Patch: Unleashing the Survival Mastery!
notes.notes:
Embark on a redefined journey with the latest 1.52 hotfix of Total Vengeance! 🛠️ Here's what awaits you:

[i]Guided Introduction:[/i] 
   Brace yourself for a riveting tutorial at the game's outset, ensuring you master the art of survival right from the start!

[i]AI Evolution:[/i]
   Experience a more natural response from wolves when you land those crucial hits. Watch them adapt and react dynamically to your every move!

[i]Character Enhancements:[/i]
[u]Dynamic Hit Reactions:[/u]
    Engage in combat with newfound freedom – now move strategically even while taking hits!

 [i]Inventory Clarity:[/i]
    No more mysteries! Addressing concerns about inventory functionality, players are reminded that they need to pick up items first before they become accessible in the inventory. Use the TAB key wisely after snagging those life-saving resources.


Unleash your survival prowess and conquer the challenges that await in🔥🎮 Total Vengeance 1.52! 🔥🎮

notes.title: PATCH 1.51
notes.notes:
[b]New arrival:[/b]
Get ready for an in-game tutorial to enhance your 'Total Vengeance' adventure!

[b]Hot Fix:[/b]
Removed Ammo boxes; they will make a comeback in an upcoming update.
The front and back gas station doors now have improved accessibility.
Health packs have been revamped for accurate health regeneration.
Miner cave helmet lights have been updated to provide better visibility as you traverse the cave system.
Money pickups have received some tweaks for a more satisfying collection.

[b]Game-play and Immersion:[/b]
Car parts have been strategically relocated for a more immersive game-play experience.
We've transformed assets to use Nanite technology for enhanced graphics and detail.
Money pickups now go straight to the player's account instead of cluttering up the inventory.
Day and night cycle time has been adjusted to provide more daylight for exploration.

[b]Bugs Squashed:[/b]
The boss now makes a grand entrance during the cut scene.
Cactus assets have been optimized, now using instance rendering for better performance.
Cactus collision spheres have been lowered and adjusted for a more realistic feel.
Say goodbye to invisible walls; players can no longer wander outside the fenced area.
Your character will no longer crouch for no reason, providing a smoother game-play experience.
Thirst, hunger, and radiation levels now decrease at a more user-friendly rate.
Annoying AI animals have been reworked to follow more realistic sight perception.
Sphere radius of cactus blueprints has been adjusted, preventing unnecessary damage from minor bumps.
Consumable items now have extended duration.
Finding items has been made easier; they come into view more readily.


We're dedicated to refining 'Total Vengeance' and value your feedback as we journey towards an even better gaming experience. Stay tuned for more exciting updates, and enjoy your adventure! 🎮🌟

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
[b]AI Adjustments:[/b]
AI Snakes and Rats now exhibit more realistic sight perception to mimic animal instincts.
AI Rat health values have been adjusted to 25% to enhance game-play balance.

[b]Game Intro Cinematic:[/b]
The game intro cinematic has been temporarily disconnected. Stay tuned for an ETA on its re-installation.

[b]Environmental Enhancements:[/b]
More foliage has been added to the level for a richer, immersive environment.
Current assets in the level have been reorganized for better game-play flow.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Various bugs have been diligently fixed to ensure a smoother gaming experience.

Thank you for your support. We're committed to delivering a top-notch adventure, and your feedback and support are invaluable. Keep the suggestions coming as we work to make "Total Vengeance" even better!

Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming! 🎮🌟
